verdict.rationale: Alloy documents workflows that run on a schedule as Portfolio workflows, and transaction monitoring that runs at scheduled times to generate alerts or investigations. Events mapped to Source Workflows are routed and evaluated automatically, and Journeys chain multiple workflows into multi-step decisioning, so automations can run in the background without manual triggering. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring schedules and triggers, substantiation of the 'agentic automation' claim beyond marketing copy, automation scope beyond fraud/compliance decisioning, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
